say:6:1510324001:0.text: Lady Merlin, no matter how many times you ask, my answer will be the same.
say:6:1510324001:0.source_cn: 梅林女士，无论再强调多少遍，我的回答都一样。

say:7:1510324002:0.text: Long before Halia was even founded, we worshipped Sarethiel. He blessed us with fertile land and endless golden fields.
say:7:1510324002:0.source_cn: 早在呼临建城之前，我们就在信仰丰饶神赛图恩，他赐予我们...

say:8:1510324003:0.text: Who would start questioning their faith because of an outsider's words?
say:8:1510324003:0.source_cn: 谁会因为外人的片面之词，就开始质疑信仰？

say:9:1510324004:0.text: I know it's hard to accept, but the disaster you're facing now comes from the very god you all believe in.
say:9:1510324004:0.source_cn: 我知道，让人相信自己正在遭受的灾厄竟然来源于所信之神，...

say:10:1510324005:0.text: But if you really saw what Sarethiel did to Halian lands... to its people... Would you even admit it, Perseus? If the truth was staring you right in the face...
say:10:1510324005:0.source_cn: 但如果真见到丰饶神对呼临的领土和他的信众做了什么……你...

say:11:1510324006:0.text: Your words alone are sacrilege. Every syllable defiles what we hold dear.
say:11:1510324006:0.source_cn: 光是在这里听你说出这些不敬的词句，已经是对信仰的亵渎。

say:12:1510324007:0.text: But I'm willing to give you a chance, my lady, because you brought back our soldiers as promised.
say:12:1510324007:0.source_cn: 但我愿意给你机会，女士。因为你依照约定，带回了我们被俘的人。

say:13:1510324008:0.text: I'm working to bring peace between your two peoples.
say:13:1510324008:0.source_cn: 我在为两族的和平而努力。

say:14:1510324009:0.text: Why must we make peace with the Wildborn? You have no stake in this!
say:14:1510324009:0.source_cn: 为什么一定要让我们和兽人握手言和呢？你和他们并无利益相关。

say:15:1510324010:0.text: Expansion and plunder won't end your suffering! Look around! Ever since you arrived, the lush greenery near Mirehold has started dying. Even the locust swarms have appeared!
say:15:1510324010:0.source_cn: 因为扩张和掠夺无法解决你们的苦难！水泽营地附近原本茂盛...

say:18:1510324013:0.text: You brought the faith of the God of Harvest into Mirehold... And now, the fallen god's corruption has followed.
say:18:1510324013:0.source_cn: 你们把对丰饶神的信仰带入了水泽营地，这片交界地，所以堕...

say:19:1510324014:1.text: Open your eyes and look. Your beloved Sarethiel has fallen. The source of all suffering lies within Halia itself.
say:19:1510324014:1.source_cn: 请睁开双眼仔细看看吧，你们信仰的丰饶神已经堕落，苦难的...

say:20:1510324015:0.text: Turn your blades and spears against the fallen god. Only then will Halia have a fighting chance.
say:20:1510324015:0.source_cn: 将你们的刀剑和长矛调转方向，终结堕神，呼临城的生命才会...

say:21:1510324016:0.text: You speak with such conviction in your words... as if you've seen gods fall with your own eyes.
say:21:1510324016:0.source_cn: 女士，你说得言之凿凿，仿佛亲眼见过神明堕落一样。

say:22:1510324017:0.text: I... Yes, I have. The solution is clear. There is no other path.
say:22:1510324017:0.source_cn: 我……是的，我见过。而且我知道解决的方法。唯一方法。

say:23:1510324018:0.text: My Lady Merlin, I'm grateful you brought back our soldiers, but you've also dragged a powerful enemy to our doorstep. The Hunting God has no love for humans.
say:23:1510324018:0.source_cn: 梅林女士，我很感激你带回了我们的亲友和兄弟，但你也给我...
say:23:1510324018:0.male: My Lady Merlin, I'm grateful you brought back our soldiers, but you've also dragged a powerful enemy to our doorstep. The Hunting God has no love for humans.
say:23:1510324018:0.female: My Lady Merlin, I'm grateful you brought back our soldiers, but you've also dragged a powerful enemy to our doorstep. The Hunting Goddess has no love for humans.

say:24:1510324019:0.text: I thank you for the former, but I cannot trust you for the latter.
say:24:1510324019:0.source_cn: 我会为第一件事感谢你，但也不会托付更多信任。

say:31:1510324024:0.text: Scouts have spotted a <style="highlight">massive swarm of needle locusts</style>! They're heading from the ravine straight toward Mirehold!
say:31:1510324024:0.source_cn: 巡哨小队发现了<style=highlight>规模巨...

say:32:1510324025:0.text: Get the troops ready and hold the line! Mirehold must not fall to the swarm!
say:32:1510324025:0.source_cn: 让士兵们立刻整装出发，不能让一只针蝗接近水泽！

say:36:1510324027:0.text: Act as you will, Lady Merlin. I have a swarm to take care of.

narration:41:1501033302:0.text: Suddenly, a massive swarm of needle locusts attacks Mirehold. Perseus leads his troops to fend them off.
narration:41:1501033302:0.source_cn: 成百上千的针蝗群突袭水泽营地，珀尔修斯带领士兵迎战。

narration:42:15010333:0.text: Gala and you hide behind a wall, eavesdropping on the conversation between Perseus and Merlin the First.
narration:42:15010333:0.source_cn: 你和加拉来到墙后，一起偷听珀尔修斯与初代梅林的谈话。
narration:42:15010333:0.male: Gala and you hide behind a wall, eavesdropping on the conversation between Perseus and Merlin the First.
narration:42:15010333:0.female: Gala and you hide behind a wall, eavesdropping on the conversation between Perseus and Merlin the First.
